video_title: EKSKLUZIVNO - Dimitris Janakopulos: Kumara završava Nikolu Jokića!

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos on bringing back Zeljko Obradovic to Panathinaikos
quotes.excerpt: I knew inside me that one day this will happen. It's fate.
quotes.quote: I knew inside me that one day this will happen. It's fate. I am very happy that it happened this year. Hopefully, we will have successful results, but as I said in the press conference as well, for me, it's a success already this season.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Znao sam u sebi da će se jednog dana ovo desiti. To je sudbina. Veoma sam srećan što se to desilo ove godine. Nadamo se da ćemo imati uspešne rezultate, ali kao što sam rekao i na konferenciji za štampu, za mene je ovo već uspeh ove sezone.

quotes.speaker: Dimitris Giannakopoulos
quotes.summary_phrase: Dimitris Giannakopoulos on his desire to bring Nikola Jokic to Panathinaikos
quotes.excerpt: I would love to see him in Panathinaikos jersey and I'm going to do whatever I can to try and do it.
quotes.quote: I stopped watching NBA the day that Jordan stopped bouncing the ball. I started watching a bit of the NBA again when Jokic went there. I believe he is top 10 players of all time. I would love to see him in Panathinaikos jersey and I'm going to do whatever I can to try and do it. The politics are difficult because I don't think it's a matter of teams, I think it's a matter of the NBA maybe not allowing such a huge star to come.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Prestao sam da gledam NBA onog dana kada je Džordan prestao da tapka loptu. Počeo sam ponovo da gledam malo NBA kada je Jokić otišao tamo. Verujem da je on u top 10 igrača svih vremena. Voleo bih da ga vidim u dresu Panatinaikosa i uradiću sve što mogu da pokušam da to uradim. Politika je teška jer mislim da nije u pitanju tim, mislim da je u pitanju NBA možda ne dozvoljava takvoj ogromnoj zvezdi da dođe.
